jei.promptcritical.info.raw_coal: Mined from coal seams underground. Each piece carries a coal assay: volatiles, ash, moisture and sulfur decide where it can go.
jei.promptcritical.process.air_separator: The rectification column splits air from the main compressor into nitrogen, oxygen and argon; liquids go to a cryogenic tank. Near the coke plant the air carries acetylene.
jei.promptcritical.process.baking_furnac: Bakes green electrodes on plant gas: 24 h above 800 °C. Unloading hot cracks them.
jei.promptcritical.process.blast_furnace: Burden of sinter or ore, coke and flux through the top; hot blast from stoves. The drill opens the taphole, the mud gun closes it with 2 taphole clay; iron runs to a ladle or sand, slag to granulation.
jei.promptcritical.process.bof_vessel: Tilt forward to charge hot metal, scrap and lime; blow oxygen through the lance upright; tilt back to tap steel into the ladle. Converter gas goes to its tank.
jei.promptcritical.process.byproduct_pla: Cooler and precipitator catch tar, the saturator binds ammonia with sulfuric acid, the scrubber takes benzol with wash oil. What is not caught stays in the gas.
jei.promptcritical.process.casting_beari: A turned bronze bearing housing crafts into two bearing shells. Porous, short-run or chilled castings are rejected.
jei.promptcritical.process.casting_impel: A turned impeller casting without defects crafts into a pump impeller.
jei.promptcritical.process.coal_jig: Run-of-mine coal is split by density into washed coal, middlings and refuse; the cut is set with a Create wrench. Make-up water by pipe or bucket.
jei.promptcritical.process.coke_oven: Cokes the coal charge for hours of heating from the flues. Coke quality follows the coal assay; gas goes to the collector main and the exhauster.
jei.promptcritical.process.crucible_furn: Melts a copper, bronze or aluminium ingot (100 kg) over coal and pours it into the mold in front. Redstone holds the crucible.
jei.promptcritical.process.cupola_furnac: Charges of iron and coke, 100 kg per item, blown by a blower on a Create shaft. Iron taps itself into a rammed mold at the foot. Redstone keeps the taphole closed.
jei.promptcritical.process.deaerator: Heats softened water with drum steam of a nearby I1 boiler to boiling and strips oxygen: boiler feedwater at 104 °C.
jei.promptcritical.process.degasificatio: Draws methane from the seam through boreholes before mining; the gas is fuel for the plant.
jei.promptcritical.process.electrode_ext: Mixes pitch coke with pitch at the binder share set on the panel (25–30 %) and presses a green electrode.
jei.promptcritical.process.fire_tube_boi: Burns solid fuel on the grate and raises steam for the steam engine on a Create shaft. Ash leaves as boiler slag; hard feed water builds scale.
jei.promptcritical.process.heat_treatmen: Heats a charge of rolled steel or pipe to the setpoint, then quenches it in the tank or cools it in air (tempering, normalizing, stress relief).
jei.promptcritical.process.hydrotest_ben: A cooled pipe is filled with water (20 mB) and pressed to 0.9 of yield: a burst pipe is scrap, a sound one is marked HYDRO.
jei.promptcritical.process.ingot_mold: A ladle above teems steel into the mold; the solid ingot comes out as hot steel ingots and head crop as scrap. A refractory brick hot top cuts the crop from 17 % to 12 %.
jei.promptcritical.process.ion_exchange_: Sodium cation exchange removes hardness. Regenerate the resin with salt.
jei.promptcritical.process.ladle_station: Ferroalloys deoxidize and alloy the steel in the ladle, argon through the plug stirs and cools it. The panel shows the grade you will cast.
jei.promptcritical.process.machine_tool: Turns or drills a casting; the cutting tool wears with use.
jei.promptcritical.process.magnetic_sepa: Four pieces of magnetite per cycle: 85 % of the iron goes to concentrate (66 % Fe), the rest to tailings. Hematite is not magnetic.
jei.promptcritical.process.milling_keywa: Mills a 12 × 8 keyway into a steel bar; the keyway tolerates a coarser feed than gear teeth.
jei.promptcritical.process.milling_machi: Cuts the teeth of a turned gear-blank casting with a disc module cutter. A coarse feed per tooth leaves the flanks too rough and the gear goes to scrap; an oversped cutter burns out in seconds.
jei.promptcritical.process.mine_drainage: Pumps mine water out of the sump to keep the workings dry.
jei.promptcritical.process.molding_stati: Jolts moist foundry sand around a pattern on a Create shaft: one rammed sand mold per cycle. The pattern is not consumed. Water 5 mB per sand item.
jei.promptcritical.process.piercing_mill: A hot billet or ingot (1200–1250 °C) is pierced on a mandrel into seamless pipe, 1 m per piece, size and purpose from the panel.
jei.promptcritical.process.pipe_welder: Forms plate into a tube and welds the seam by high frequency; off-optimum speed or power leaves hidden weld defects.
jei.promptcritical.process.pitch_coke: Coal tar pitch charged into an oven gives pitch coke, the filler for electrodes.
jei.promptcritical.process.quench_tower: Hot coke is wet-quenched: 0.45 kg of water boils off per kg, coke leaves with 4 % moisture.
jei.promptcritical.process.recording_gau: Writes the measured value onto chart paper over time; the recorded chart is read in the chart viewer.
jei.promptcritical.process.reheating_fur: Heats ingots and billets to the setpoint (1150–1250 °C) and pushes them out onto the roller table. Above 1300 °C the steel burns.
jei.promptcritical.process.rolling_mill_: Each pass through the rolls with the gap set on the panel reduces the bar; the product (billet, plate, rod, beam) follows the passes. Overload shears the pin: an iron nugget is a new pin.
jei.promptcritical.process.sand_filter: Removes suspended matter after the clarifier. Backwash with Shift + right click with an empty hand.
jei.promptcritical.process.shakeout_grat: Knocks cooled molds out on a Create shaft: the casting with its spec and 90 % of the sand back.
jei.promptcritical.process.shaping_plate: Planes a rolled steel plate flat for the surface grinder.
jei.promptcritical.process.shaping_slide: Planes a machine-bed casting into a slideway and a base-plate casting into a plate. The tool cuts on the forward stroke only; the slideway needs a fine feed.
jei.promptcritical.process.sinter_strand: Ten items of ore or concentrate per cycle with coke breeze (45–70 kg/t) and flux for the basicity set on the panel; ignited with plant gas.
jei.promptcritical.process.slag_granulat: Liquid slag from the runner is quenched by a water jet into granulated slag.
jei.promptcritical.process.surface_grind: Grinds a planed plate flat. A deep down-feed or a loaded wheel burns the surface; spinning the wheel past 1.5 × its working speed bursts it.
jei.promptcritical.process.water_clarifi: Lime softening and settling of raw water. Needs burnt lime.
jei.promptcritical.process.water_tube_bo: Fires coal dust or plant gas through burners under BMS interlocks and feeds superheated steam to steam engines. Purge, igniter trial and main fuel are run from the panel.

promptcritical.mine.self_rescuer.on: Self-rescuer on: breathing from the apparatus
A blast furnace is a ring of shell blocks 5 wide and 12 to 18 high; this one is cut short
Coke, sinter and limestone go in at the top in layers
Hot blast through the tuyeres burns the coke; the carbon monoxide reduces the iron ore
Iron and slag gather in the hearth. The cast house drill opens the taphole
Iron runs along the runner into a ladle; the mud gun then plugs the taphole with clay
promptcritical.ponder.coke_battery_cycle: Narrow coking chambers alternate with heating flue walls of silica brick
Coal is charged from the top. Coking time grows with the square of the chamber width
Coke oven gas rises into the collecting main and goes on to the exhausters and the by-product plant
A coked chamber is emptied by a pusher ram mounted on a Create contraption
Red-hot coke must be quenched at once, or it burns away in the air
promptcritical.ponder.generator_synchron: The generator turns with a Create shaft; the exciter supplies its field current
Before the breaker closes, voltage, frequency and phase of the generator must match the bus
The synchroscope pointer turns with the slip: clockwise means the generator is fast
Close the breaker when the pointer turns slowly and comes up to twelve o'clock
A clean closing keeps the torque shock within 10 %; far out of phase it damages the shaft or shears the coupling
promptcritical.ponder.grid_frequency.tex: Frequency is the same across the whole grid and holds while generation equals the load
When load exceeds generation, the rotors slow down and the frequency falls
Under-frequency load shedding modules in the consumers disconnect them stage by stage
With part of the load gone, the frequency recovers; the rest of the grid stays in service
When the frequency is back, frequency auto-reclose returns the shed consumers
promptcritical.ponder.relay_ladder.text_: A relay circuit: a 24 V supply, buttons, relays and a lamp, wired terminal to terminal
Contacts in series make AND, contacts in parallel make OR
Pressing START energises the coil of K1
A K1 contact in parallel with START keeps the coil energised: this is the seal-in
K2 follows K1 and lights the lamp through its contact
The normally closed STOP button breaks the circuit and everything drops out
